summary: Create an external-postgres-configuration Secret with host, port (default 5432), database, username, password (no quotes or backslashes) and type unmanaged, oc create it, then set spec.database.database_secret on the AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR.
questions: How do I create the external database secret for the platform gateway?
Secret format for external PostgreSQL on the AAP Operator
Why should the database password not contain quotes?
Set database_secret on the AAP CR

answer_card.title: External database for the gateway
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: external-postgres-configuration
  namespace: <target_namespace>
stringData:
  host: "<db_host>"
  port: "5432"
  database: "<db_name>"
  username: "<user>"
  password: "<password>"   # no ', " or \
  type: "unmanaged"
type: Opaque
```
`oc create -f external-postgres-configuration-secret.yml`, then:
```yaml
spec:
  database:
    database_secret: <secret-name>
```
